epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease task status discrepancy incidents from current 15% baseline to 0%
requirements: R1: Correct task state synchronization to accurately mirror real GitHub PR states

slices.title: Patch PR state synchronization logic with atomic updates
slices.jtbd: When implementing the state reconciliation patch for this epic, I want to fix the desynchronization bug in existing code, so that the epic's outcome of accurate operational reality is achieved.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given a task synchronization event processing a GitHub PR state
When the system evaluates the PR status
Then the internal task record must be updated using an atomically-guarded SQL update (e.g., UPDATE ... WHERE id = ? AND status = ?) to reflect the true GitHub PR state
And tests must assert correct behavior to cover the QA floor for this single-slice epic
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce false positive 'done' synchronization errors from current 15% baseline to 0%
